SOFTWARE LICENCE AND SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made between Helios Software Sdn. Bhd. (the "Supplier") and
Meridian Retail Ltd. (the "Client").

ARTICLE I
DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION

1.1 "Confidential Information" means all non-public information disclosed by
one party to the other, whether orally, in writing or in machine-readable form,
and includes source code, pricing and customer lists.

1.2 "Deliverable" means any software, report or dataset that the Supplier
produces specifically for the Client under this Agreement.

1.3 "Effective Date" means the date on which the last party signs this
Agreement.

ARTICLE II
FEES AND PAYMENT

2.1 Payment Terms

The Client shall pay undisputed invoices within thirty (30) days of receipt.
All amounts are stated exclusive of any applicable sales and service tax.
Late payment interest of one and one half percent (1.5%) per month may accrue on
overdue undisputed amounts, calculated from the due date until payment is
received in full, and the Supplier may suspend services while any undisputed
invoice remains overdue by more than sixty (60) days after written notice.

2.2 Set-Off

The Client may not set off any amount against fees payable under this Agreement
unless the Supplier has agreed in writing.

ARTICLE III
TERM AND TERMINATION

3.1 Termination for Convenience

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days
written notice to the other party.

3.2 Termination for Cause

A party may terminate this Agreement immediately if the other party commits a
material breach and fails to cure that breach within fifteen (15) days of
written notice.

3.3 Consequences of Termination

On termination the following consequences apply.

3.3(a) Accrued Fees

The Client shall pay all fees for work performed before the effective date of
termination.

3.3(b) Return of Materials

The Supplier shall return or destroy the Client's Confidential Information on
request.

ARTICLE IV
CONFIDENTIALITY AND LIABILITY

4.1 Confidentiality

Each party shall protect the other party's Confidential Information using no
less than a reasonable degree of care and shall not disclose it to third
parties except as required by law.

4.2 Limitation of Liability

Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss. Each party's total
aggregate liability under this Agreement is limited to the fees paid or payable
in the twelve (12) months before the claim arose.

SCHEDULE 1
SERVICE LEVELS

The Supplier shall maintain 99.9% availability excluding scheduled maintenance,
measured monthly.
